scope: P-FP: add self-contained baremetal FP/NEON performance workloads for scalar FP32/FP64 latency/throughput, scalar FP16 throughput, and NEON 128-bit integer/FP vector add/mul/fma/load-store throughput. No Verilator or Quartus run.

runs.command: for f in baremetal/perf/t_fp_scalar.c baremetal/perf/t_fp_fp16.c baremetal/perf/t_neon_vect.c; do aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -O2 -ffreestanding -nostdlib -nostartfiles -mabi=lp64 -Wall -Wextra -c $f -o /tmp/$(basename ${f%.c}).o; done
runs.summary: All three P-FP sources compile cleanly without -mgeneral-regs-only; FP16 H instructions and NEON 2S/4S/2D instructions are emitted directly.

runs.command: for f in t_fp_scalar t_fp_fp16 t_neon_vect; do aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -O2 -ffreestanding -nostdlib -nostartfiles -mabi=lp64 -DPERF_STANDALONE -I baremetal -c baremetal/perf/$f.c -o /tmp/${f}_sa.o && aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -O2 -ffreestanding -nostdlib -mabi=lp64 -c baremetal/startup_mb.s -o /tmp/startup_mb.o && aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -nostdlib -T baremetal/link.ld -o /tmp/$f.elf /tmp/startup_mb.o /tmp/${f}_sa.o && aarch64-linux-gnu-objcopy -O binary /tmp/$f.elf /tmp/$f.bin; done
runs.summary: Each workload links into a standalone bare-metal ELF/bin using PERF_STANDALONE and the existing startup/linker without changing shared build inputs.

known_limits: perf_common.h is not merged; each file is self-contained as requested.
The three workloads are not wired into scripts/build-microbench.sh, microbench_main.c, or the Makefile; standalone PERF_STANDALONE build/run is provided.
FP/NEON files require compilation without -mgeneral-regs-only because they intentionally use FP/SIMD registers.
CPACR_EL1.FPEN must be set by the workload before FP/NEON use; each run_test_* enables FPEN=11 at EL1.
Current P7 RTL does not implement NEON integer MUL (UDEF); t_neon_vect.c covers 128-bit integer ADD plus FP vector MUL/FMLA.
No Verilator microbench_runner execution, no Quartus, and no actual cycle measurements were performed; only compile/link verification.
Performance data is proxy only and is not an A10/Fmax or architectural signoff.
